run_structure_generator: run the StructureGenerator to create adsorbate on slab placements and write vasp input files
precompute_slabs: precompute slab surfaces for bulk materials and save vasp input files to disk
generate_heuristic_placements: generate heuristic adsorbate placements on a slab surface using the AdsorbateSlabConfig class
generate_random_placements: generate random adsorbate placements with configurable rotations on a slab surface
write_surface_vasp_files: write vasp input files and metadata pickle for a specified slab surface
